notes: Single-seed 64-frame visual screens, not a four-seed statistical win.
World cache is a bounded surface-oriented RGB diffuse cache populated from visible mature estimates; it does not trace offscreen probes or know unseen surfaces.
Blue noise only changes secondary BSDF direction coordinates. Integer whole-tile translation preserves spatial blue noise; it is not STBN.
Screen lookup retains an any-hit BVH visibility check and closest-hit fallback. Slower in Sponza; off by default.
Performance is GPU renderer/denoiser time; excludes presentation, UI and browser scheduling.
Specular is per-pixel, outside the diffuse cache and fade; still passes through the existing final denoiser.
Moving analytic lights and camera motion tested. Mesh deformation is not supported by this app path and is not claimed validated.
